title: Ultimate Kerala Highlands & Backwaters Tour Package
shortDescription: Discover the magic of God's Own Country in 2026. Explore Munnar's mist-covered tea estates, spot wildlife in Thekkady, and cruise the Alleppey backwaters on a luxury houseboat.
highlights: Scenic drive through Cheeyappara waterfalls and tea estates
Hidden Gem: Parunthumpara (Eagle's Rock) panoramic viewpoint
Wildlife safari and spice plantation tour in Thekkady
Luxury overnight houseboat cruise in Alleppey
Comfortable premium hotels with private transfers
overview: Escape into the heart of Kerala on this expertly optimized five-day itinerary. Start in Kochi and ascend into Munnar's rolling tea gardens. Journey south through the hidden gem of Parunthumpara to the spice hub of Thekkady for a wildlife experience. Conclude by unwinding aboard a traditional deluxe houseboat gliding through Alleppey's peaceful backwaters. Featuring premium accommodations and seamless private transport, this tour offers the perfect balance of adventure and relaxation.
accommodation: 2 nights premium 4-star hotel (Munnar), 1 night premium hotel (Thekkady), 1 night deluxe AC houseboat (Alleppey). Twin/triple sharing.
transportation: Private AC sedan/SUV with a professional chauffeur for all transfers.
meals: Breakfast (Days 2-5). Alleppey houseboat includes all meals (Lunch, Evening Snacks, Dinner, Breakfast).
weather: Pleasant year-round. Munnar is cool (12°C-24°C); Thekkady & Alleppey are tropical (22°C-33°C).

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & Ascent to Munnar
itinerary.morning: Arrive at Kochi Airport/Railway Station. Meet your chauffeur and begin the ascent into the Western Ghats.
itinerary.afternoon: Stop at the cascading Cheeyappara and Valara Waterfalls. Enjoy fresh coconut water while viewing the lush spice gardens.
itinerary.evening: Check into your Munnar resort. Enjoy a relaxed evening walking through the local bazaar.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Estates & National Park
itinerary.morning: Visit Eravikulam National Park to spot the endangered Nilgiri Tahr against the backdrop of Anamudi Peak.
itinerary.afternoon: Explore the Tea Museum, Mattupetty Dam, and Echo Point. Enjoy a serene boat ride on Kundala Lake.
itinerary.evening: Return to the resort for a warm dinner in the cool mountain climate.

itinerary.title: Hidden Gems & Spice Plantations
itinerary.morning: Drive towards Thekkady. En route, detour to the hidden gem of Parunthumpara (Eagle's Rock) for sweeping canyon views.
itinerary.afternoon: Check in at Thekkady. Enjoy a guided spice plantation tour, learning about cardamom, pepper, and cinnamon.
itinerary.evening: Experience Kerala's rich culture with an optional Kathakali or Kalaripayattu martial arts show.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Houseboat Backwater Cruise
itinerary.morning: Descend from the hills to the coastal plains of Alleppey. Board your traditional private houseboat.
itinerary.afternoon: Cruise the emerald backwaters, passing paddy fields and local villages. Enjoy an authentic Keralite lunch onboard.
itinerary.evening: Watch the sunset from the deck, followed by a romantic dinner and overnight stay on the water.

itinerary.title: Kochi Heritage & Departure
itinerary.morning: Enjoy a floating breakfast before disembarking the houseboat at 9:00 AM.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive to Fort Kochi. Explore the Chinese Fishing Nets, Jew Town, and Mattancherry Palace.
itinerary.evening: Transfer to Kochi Airport for your onward journey.

inclusions: Private AC vehicle with expert driver
2 nights in Munnar, 1 night in Thekkady

faq.question: What makes this optimized route better?
faq.answer: This route minimizes driving time by following a natural loop: Kochi -> Munnar (hills) -> Thekkady (forests) -> Alleppey (coast) -> Kochi, ensuring no backtracking.

faq.question: Is the Alleppey houseboat safe for children?
faq.answer: Yes, our houseboats are fully safety-compliant and highly recommended for families.

title: Kerala Weekend Escape
shortDescription: A refreshing Kerala getaway featuring misty hills, scenic waterfalls, lush tea plantations, and an unforgettable overnight houseboat experience in Alleppey.
highlights: Explore Munnar's tea gardens and mountain viewpoints
Relax aboard a traditional Alleppey houseboat
Visit iconic waterfalls and scenic landscapes
Private transfers with comfortable premium stays
overview: Perfect for travelers with limited time, this four-day Kerala escape combines the cool hills of Munnar with the tranquil backwaters of Alleppey. Journey through picturesque waterfalls, tea plantations, and breathtaking viewpoints before unwinding aboard a deluxe houseboat. Carefully planned with comfortable accommodations, seamless transportation, and authentic local experiences, this itinerary offers the perfect blend of nature, relaxation, and culture.
pickupLocation: Kochi International Airport (COK) or Ernakulam Railway Station
accommodation: 2 nights in a premium 3-star/4-star hotel in Munnar and 1 night aboard a deluxe AC houseboat in Alleppey on twin/triple sharing basis.
transportation: Private air-conditioned sedan/SUV with experienced driver for all sightseeing and transfers.
meals: Breakfast from Day 2 onwards and all meals during the Alleppey houseboat stay (Lunch, Dinner & Breakfast).
weather: Munnar enjoys cool temperatures between 12°C-24°C, while Alleppey remains warm and tropical at 24°C-33°C throughout most of the year.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & Journey to Munnar
itinerary.morning: Arrive at Kochi Airport or Railway Station before beginning your scenic drive into Kerala's highlands.
itinerary.afternoon: Stop at beautiful waterfalls and enjoy panoramic views as you travel through spice plantations and winding mountain roads.
itinerary.evening: Check into your hotel in Munnar and spend a relaxed evening exploring nearby cafés or local markets.

itinerary.title: Discover the Best of Munnar
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, visit Eravikulam National Park and admire the rolling tea estates surrounding the region.
itinerary.afternoon: Continue to Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, Kundala Lake, Blossom Park, and other scenic attractions.
itinerary.evening: Return to the hotel and enjoy a peaceful evening amidst the cool mountain weather.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Alleppey Houseboat Experience
itinerary.morning: Check out after breakfast and drive towards the enchanting backwaters of Alleppey.
itinerary.afternoon: Board your deluxe houseboat and enjoy a freshly prepared lunch while cruising through peaceful canals, paddy fields, and village landscapes.
itinerary.evening: Witness a spectacular sunset over the backwaters before enjoying dinner and an overnight stay aboard the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Return to Kochi & Departure
itinerary.morning: Enjoy breakfast onboard before disembarking from the houseboat.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive back to Kochi with an optional stop at Fort Kochi or Marine Drive if your departure schedule allows.
itinerary.evening: Transfer to Kochi Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey.

inclusions: Private AC sedan/SUV for all transfers and sightseeing
1 night deluxe AC houseboat stay in Alleppey
Lunch, Dinner, and Breakfast during the houseboat stay
exclusions: Personal expenses such as shopping, beverages, and laundry
Adventure activities and optional water sports
Expenses due to weather, roadblocks, or itinerary changes

faq.question: Is this trip suitable for a long weekend?
faq.answer: Yes. This itinerary is designed for travelers looking to experience Kerala's highlights within four days.

faq.question: Does the package include the Alleppey houseboat stay?
faq.answer: Yes. One overnight stay aboard a deluxe AC houseboat with meals is included.

faq.question: Can families with children join this trip?
faq.answer: Absolutely. The itinerary is family-friendly and suitable for couples, children, and senior citizens.

faq.question: Will we visit Fort Kochi?
faq.answer: Fort Kochi sightseeing is optional on the final day and depends on your departure timing.

title: Gokarna, Dandeli & Murudeshwar Coastal Adventure
shortDescription: Combine the thrill of Dandeli river rafting with the serene beaches of Gokarna and the majestic Murudeshwar temple on this ultimate Karnataka coastal road trip.
highlights: White-water rafting on the Kali River in Dandeli
Hidden Gem: Explore the historic Mirjan Fort
Trek the famous Five/Seven Beaches of Gokarna
Visit the towering Shiva Statue at Murudeshwar
Serene mangrove boat ride in Honnavar
overview: An action-packed coastal and jungle adventure! Start with adrenaline-pumping white-water rafting in Dandeli's dense forests. Transition to the laid-back hippie vibes of Gokarna for a famous beach trek. We've optimized the return route to include a stop at the hidden gem of Mirjan Fort, before admiring the colossal Murudeshwar Shiva statue and floating through the Honnavar mangroves. A flawless blend of thrills, spirituality, and relaxation.
accommodation: 1 night riverside cottage (Dandeli), 2 nights premium AC beach resort (Gokarna). Twin/triple sharing.
transportation: AC Tempo Traveller / SUV for local sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Kali River Adventure in Dandeli
itinerary.morning: Arrive in Hubballi and drive straight to the Dandeli jungle camp. Freshen up and grab breakfast.
itinerary.afternoon: Gear up for white-water rafting on the Kali River. Try kayaking, zorbing, and wild swimming.
itinerary.evening: Campfire, music, and a hearty buffet dinner by the river.

itinerary.title: Vibhuti Falls & Gokarna Sunsets
itinerary.morning: Drive towards Gokarna. En route, take a short hike to the pristine Vibhuti Falls for a refreshing dip.
itinerary.afternoon: Arrive in Gokarna. Visit the Mahabaleshwar Temple, then head to Kudle Beach for lunch and relaxation.
itinerary.evening: Watch a spectacular sunset at Om Beach. Check into your beachside resort.

itinerary.title: The Ultimate Beach Trek
itinerary.morning: Embark on the famous Gokarna Beach Trek covering Paradise, Half Moon, and Om Beach.
itinerary.afternoon: Free time for cafe hopping, relaxing in hammocks, or trying out beachside water sports.
itinerary.evening: Stroll through Gokarna's flea markets and enjoy a seaside dinner.

itinerary.title: Mirjan Fort, Murudeshwar & Departure
itinerary.morning: Checkout and explore the hidden gem: Mirjan Fort, a stunning 16th-century laterite structure.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive to Murudeshwar. Witness the towering 123-ft Shiva statue. Proceed to Honnavar for a peaceful mangrove boat ride.
itinerary.evening: Drive back to Hubballi to board your return bus/train.

faq.question: Is rafting safe for non-swimmers?
faq.answer: Yes, life jackets are mandatory and professional guides accompany every raft.

title: Ultimate Coorg & Chikmagalur Coffee Hills Tour
shortDescription: A highly optimized weekend route covering Karnataka's highest peaks in Chikmagalur, the lush coffee estates of Coorg, and the heritage of Mysuru.
highlights: Stand atop Mullayanagiri, Karnataka's highest peak
Hidden Gem: The tranquil Hirekolale Lake in Chikmagalur
Off-road Jeep Safari to Mandalpatti in Coorg
Visit Namdroling Monastery (Golden Temple)
Optimized circular route to minimize travel fatigue
overview: We have re-engineered this itinerary to provide the ultimate geographical flow. Starting from Bengaluru, you'll head directly to the towering peaks of Chikmagalur, visiting the hidden gem of Hirekolale Lake. Day two takes you south to the misty coffee plantations and waterfalls of Coorg. Day three concludes with a seamless drive through the royal city of Mysuru back to Bengaluru, eliminating backtracking and maximizing your time in nature.
accommodation: 1 night Chikmagalur hotel, 1 night Coorg resort. Twin/triple sharing.
transportation: AC Tempo Traveller / Innova for the entire circuit.

itinerary.title: Bengaluru to Chikmagalur Peaks
itinerary.morning: Depart Bengaluru early. Drive to Chikmagalur. Visit the historic Belur Temple en route.
itinerary.afternoon: Trek up to Mullayanagiri Peak for sweeping views of the Western Ghats.
itinerary.evening: Visit the hidden gem: Hirekolale Lake for a quiet sunset. Check into your Chikmagalur hotel.

itinerary.title: Chikmagalur to Coorg Wilderness
itinerary.morning: Drive to Coorg. Head straight to the cascading Abbey Falls surrounded by spice estates.
itinerary.afternoon: Take a thrilling 4x4 Jeep ride to Mandalpatti peak for dramatic valley views.
itinerary.evening: Watch the sunset from Raja's Seat. Check into your Coorg nature resort.

itinerary.title: Monasteries, Mysuru & Return
itinerary.morning: Visit the Namdroling Golden Temple and interact with elephants at Dubare Elephant Camp.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive down to Mysuru. View the majestic Mysore Palace and stop for local shopping.
itinerary.evening: Return to Bengaluru, completing a perfect geographical loop.

faq.question: Why was this route optimized?
faq.answer: Traveling Bengaluru -> Chikmagalur -> Coorg -> Mysuru -> Bengaluru forms a clean circle, saving over 4 hours of unnecessary driving compared to older routes.

title: Coorg Weekend Escape
shortDescription: A perfect weekend getaway to Coorg featuring scenic viewpoints, waterfalls, adventure activities, elephant encounters, and the famous Golden Temple.
highlights: Jeep safari to Mandalpatti Peak
Abbey Falls and Raja's Seat sunset
Golden Temple and Elephant Camp
Glass Bridge & Zipline adventure
overview: Escape the city and immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of Coorg. From panoramic mountain viewpoints and cascading waterfalls to thrilling adventure activities and peaceful monasteries, this carefully curated weekend itinerary offers the perfect blend of relaxation, nature, and excitement. Ideal for friends, couples, solo travelers, and families looking for an unforgettable short break.
accommodation: 1 Night stay in a premium hotel/resort on twin or triple sharing basis.
transportation: AC Sleeper/Seater Bus from Bengaluru with local sightseeing in Tempo Traveller or similar vehicle.
weather: Pleasant throughout the year with temperatures ranging between 14°C and 28°C. Monsoon offers lush greenery while winter provides cool weather.

itinerary.title: Adventure & Scenic Coorg
itinerary.morning: Arrive in Coorg after an overnight journey. Freshen up and begin the day with a scenic jeep ride to Mandalpatti Peak for spectacular Western Ghats views.
itinerary.afternoon: Visit the beautiful Abbey Falls before experiencing exciting activities like the Glass Bridge and Zipline (optional). Continue through coffee plantations and local viewpoints.
itinerary.evening: Watch the sunset from Raja's Seat before checking into your hotel. Enjoy dinner and relax for the night.

itinerary.title: Wildlife, Heritage & Return
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, visit Dubare/Harangi Elephant Camp and interact with elephants in a natural environment.
itinerary.afternoon: Explore the magnificent Namdroling Golden Temple (Bylakuppe), followed by Nisargadhama Island and its hanging bridge surrounded by bamboo groves and the Cauvery River.
itinerary.evening: Begin your comfortable return journey to Bengaluru with unforgettable memories of Coorg.

inclusions: Local sightseeing by Tempo Traveller or similar vehicle

faq.question: Is the Mandalpatti Jeep Safari included?
faq.answer: The safari is generally payable on-site unless specifically mentioned in your booking package.

faq.question: Are Glass Bridge and Zipline included?
faq.answer: These are optional adventure activities and usually require separate payment.

faq.question: Is this trip suitable for families?
faq.answer: Yes. The itinerary is beginner-friendly and suitable for families, couples, and solo travellers.

faq.question: What is the best time to visit Coorg?
faq.answer: October to March offers cool and pleasant weather, while the monsoon season is perfect for lush green landscapes and waterfalls.

title: Complete Tamil Nadu Hills: Ooty to Kodaikanal
shortDescription: The ultimate 5-day Tamil Nadu hill station expedition featuring the Adiyogi statue, Ooty's tea gardens, and the misty pine forests of Kodaikanal.
highlights: Blessings at the 112-ft Adiyogi Shiva Statue
Hidden Gem: Avalanche Lake in Ooty
Hidden Gem: Mannavanur Sheep Farm in Kodaikanal
Boating on both Ooty Lake and Kodai Lake
Scenic Coonoor viewpoints (Dolphin's Nose & Lamb's Rock)
overview: Experience the absolute best of the Nilgiri and Palani hills on this seamless road trip. Begin in Coimbatore with the grand Adiyogi statue before winding up to Ooty's colonial charm. We've enhanced the Ooty leg to include the breathtaking Avalanche Lake. After exploring Coonoor's tea estates, you'll take a scenic drive down and back up into the misty, pine-covered cliffs of Kodaikanal, stopping at the idyllic Mannavanur village.
accommodation: 2 nights premium Ooty hotel, 2 nights premium Kodaikanal hotel.
transportation: Private AC Sedan/SUV for the entire trip.
weather: Cool year-round (10°C to 24°C). Light woolens recommended.

itinerary.title: Adiyogi & Ascent to Ooty
itinerary.morning: Pickup from Coimbatore. Visit the magnificent Isha Yoga Center and Adiyogi Statue.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive up the Nilgiri Ghat roads. Check into your Ooty hotel.
itinerary.evening: Enjoy an evening boat ride on Ooty Lake and visit the Botanical Gardens.

itinerary.title: Avalanche Lake & Coonoor Vistas
itinerary.morning: Visit the hidden gem: Avalanche Lake, a pristine, uncrowded natural reserve.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive to Coonoor. Visit Sim's Park, Dolphin's Nose, and Lamb's Rock overlooking the plains.
itinerary.evening: Return to Ooty. Try homemade Nilgiri chocolates at Charing Cross.

itinerary.title: Epic Drive to Kodaikanal
itinerary.morning: Early checkout. Begin the scenic drive descending from the Nilgiris and ascending the Palani Hills to Kodaikanal.
itinerary.afternoon: Stop at Silver Cascade Falls. Check into your Kodaikanal resort.
itinerary.evening: Take a leisurely stroll along the famous Coaker's Walk.

itinerary.title: Pillar Rocks & Mannavanur
itinerary.morning: Visit the majestic Pillar Rocks, Pine Forest, and Guna Caves.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive to the hidden gem of Mannavanur Sheep Farm for rolling green meadows and a serene lake.
itinerary.evening: Boating or cycling around the star-shaped Kodai Lake.

itinerary.title: Descent to Coimbatore & Departure
itinerary.morning: Visit Kurinji Andavar Temple and grab some eucalyptus oil from the market.
itinerary.afternoon: Begin the descent back to Coimbatore.
itinerary.evening: Drop-off at Coimbatore Airport/Railway Station.

faq.question: Is the drive from Ooty to Kodaikanal long?
faq.answer: Yes, it takes about 6.5 hours. We schedule this as a relaxed driving day with scenic stops.

title: Ooty & Kodaikanal Grand Escape
shortDescription: Experience two of South India's most beautiful hill stations with scenic lakes, tea gardens, waterfalls, pine forests, and breathtaking mountain viewpoints.
highlights: Explore Ooty's gardens, lakes and tea estates
Witness panoramic views from Doddabetta Peak
Visit Pillar Rocks, Pine Forest & Guna Caves
Enjoy boating at Kodai Lake and walk along Coaker's Walk
overview: Discover the finest hill stations of Tamil Nadu on this carefully crafted four-day getaway. Begin your journey in Ooty, the Queen of Hill Stations, where lush tea plantations, colonial charm, and misty mountains create unforgettable memories. Continue to the serene landscapes of Kodaikanal, renowned for its pine forests, sparkling lake, dramatic viewpoints, and pleasant climate. Ideal for honeymooners, families, photographers, and nature lovers, this itinerary combines scenic beauty, relaxation, and local experiences into one unforgettable holiday.
pickupLocation: Coimbatore International Airport / Coimbatore Junction Railway Station
accommodation: 2 Nights in a premium hotel in Ooty and 1 Night in a premium hotel in Kodaikanal on twin/triple sharing basis.
transportation: Private AC Sedan, SUV or Tempo Traveller for all transfers and sightseeing.
weather: Cool and pleasant throughout the year with temperatures ranging between 10°C and 24°C. Evenings remain chilly, especially during winter.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Explore Ooty
itinerary.morning: Arrive at Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station and enjoy a scenic drive through the Nilgiri Hills to Ooty. Check into your hotel and freshen up before sightseeing.
itinerary.afternoon: Visit the Government Botanical Garden followed by the famous Government Rose Garden. Stroll through beautifully maintained flower beds and enjoy the pleasant hill weather.
itinerary.evening: Enjoy boating at Ooty Lake and explore Charing Cross Market for homemade chocolates, Nilgiri tea, spices, and handicrafts before returning to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Discover the Best of Ooty
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, visit Doddabetta Peak for panoramic views of the Nilgiri Hills. Continue to the Tea Factory & Museum to experience tea manufacturing and enjoy fresh tea tasting.
itinerary.afternoon: Visit Pine Forest, Shooting Point, Pykara Lake and Pykara Waterfalls. Optional boating is available at Pykara Lake.
itinerary.evening: Return to Ooty and enjoy free time exploring cafés or shopping before dinner.

itinerary.title: Journey to Kodaikanal
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, check out and drive through scenic mountain roads towards Kodaikanal. En route enjoy picturesque valley views and lush countryside.
itinerary.afternoon: Upon arrival, visit Silver Cascade Falls, Bryant Park, and the famous Coaker's Walk overlooking the Palani Hills.
itinerary.evening: Spend your evening boating or cycling around Kodai Lake before exploring the local market known for handmade chocolates, eucalyptus oil, and souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Kodaikanal Sightseeing & Departure
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, visit Green Valley View, Pillar Rocks, Guna Caves (Devil's Kitchen), Pine Forest, and Moir Point while enjoying breathtaking views of the surrounding valleys.
itinerary.afternoon: Visit Kurinji Andavar Temple and Shenbaganur Museum (time permitting) before beginning your return journey to Coimbatore.
itinerary.evening: Drop at Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Tamil Nadu's hill stations.

inclusions: Pickup and drop from Coimbatore Airport/Railway Station
Private AC vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing
exclusions: Boating charges at Ooty and Kodai Lake
Entry tickets to monuments and attractions
Anything not specifically mentioned under inclusions
packingList: Cash for shopping and local expenses

faq.question: Which hill station is colder, Ooty or Kodaikanal?
faq.answer: Both enjoy pleasant weather year-round, but Ooty is generally slightly cooler, especially during winter mornings and nights.

faq.question: Is boating included in the package?
faq.answer: No. Boating at Ooty Lake, Pykara Lake, and Kodai Lake is optional and can be booked directly at the respective locations.

faq.question: Is this package suitable for honeymoon couples?
faq.answer: Yes. This itinerary is one of the most popular honeymoon packages, combining romantic lakes, scenic viewpoints, peaceful walks, and comfortable accommodations.

faq.question: Can the itinerary be customized?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Attractions such as Coonoor, Avalanche Lake, Dolphin's Nose, Berijam Lake, Mannavanur, or the Nilgiri Mountain Railway can be added based on your preferences and available travel time.

title: Coimbatore & Kodaikanal Retreat
shortDescription: Experience the perfect blend of spirituality, waterfalls, pine forests, scenic viewpoints, and tranquil lakes on this memorable Coimbatore and Kodaikanal getaway.
highlights: Visit the majestic Adiyogi Shiva Statue
Boating and cycling around Kodai Lake
Explore Pillar Rocks, Guna Caves & Pine Forest
Enjoy panoramic valley views from Coaker's Walk and Moir Point
overview: Discover the spiritual charm of Coimbatore and the breathtaking beauty of Kodaikanal on this relaxing four-day holiday. Begin your journey with iconic attractions like the Adiyogi Shiva Statue and Marudhamalai Temple before heading into the mist-covered Palani Hills. Explore waterfalls, lush pine forests, dramatic viewpoints, serene lakes, colonial-era walking trails, and colorful botanical gardens. Carefully curated for families, honeymoon couples, and weekend travelers, this itinerary combines relaxation, sightseeing, and unforgettable natural beauty.
pickupLocation: Coimbatore International Airport / Coimbatore Junction Railway Station
accommodation: 3 Nights stay in a premium 3-Star or 4-Star hotel/resort in Kodaikanal on twin/triple sharing basis.
transportation: Private AC Sedan, SUV or Tempo Traveller for all airport transfers and sightseeing.
weather: Pleasant throughout the year with temperatures ranging from 10°C to 24°C. Evenings remain cool and comfortable.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Coimbatore & Journey to Kodaikanal
itinerary.morning: Arrive at Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station and meet your tour representative. Visit the iconic 112-ft Adiyogi Shiva Statue at the Isha Yoga Center and, if time permits, the famous Marudhamalai Murugan Temple.
itinerary.afternoon: Begin the scenic drive towards Kodaikanal through winding ghat roads, lush valleys, and picturesque landscapes. Stop at Silver Cascade Falls for photographs before reaching the hill station.
itinerary.evening: Check into your hotel and spend the evening relaxing or exploring the lively local market famous for homemade chocolates, eucalyptus oil, spices, and handicrafts.

itinerary.title: Explore the Best of Kodaikanal
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, enjoy a peaceful walk along Coaker's Walk followed by visits to Green Valley View and the beautiful Bryant Park.
itinerary.afternoon: Continue to Pillar Rocks, Guna Caves (Devil's Kitchen), Pine Forest, and Moir Point while enjoying breathtaking mountain scenery throughout the journey.
itinerary.evening: Spend your evening boating or cycling around the picturesque Kodai Lake before returning to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Nature, Heritage & Leisure
itinerary.morning: Visit Shenbaganur Museum to explore the region's fascinating flora, fauna, and tribal heritage. Continue to Kurinji Andavar Temple for panoramic valley views.
itinerary.afternoon: Explore Upper Lake View, Silent Valley View, and Chettiar Park before enjoying free time for shopping or visiting charming cafés around Kodai Lake.
itinerary.evening: Relax amidst the cool mountain weather or enjoy an optional campfire experience arranged by the resort (subject to availability).

itinerary.title: Return to Coimbatore
itinerary.morning: Enjoy breakfast before checking out of the hotel. Begin your drive back through the scenic Palani Hills towards Coimbatore.
itinerary.afternoon: Depending on your departure schedule, stop for shopping or refreshments before reaching the city.
itinerary.evening: Drop at Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Tamil Nadu's beautiful hill country.

inclusions: Pickup and drop from Coimbatore Airport/Railway Station
Private AC vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing
exclusions: Boating and cycling charges at Kodai Lake
Entry tickets to monuments and attractions
Personal expenses including shopping and laundry
Anything not specifically mentioned under inclusions

faq.question: Can the Adiyogi Statue be covered on the first day?
faq.answer: Yes. Since it is located near Coimbatore Airport, it is conveniently included before proceeding to Kodaikanal.

faq.question: Is boating at Kodai Lake included in the package?
faq.answer: No. Boating and cycling are optional activities and can be booked directly at Kodai Lake.

faq.question: Is this package suitable for honeymoon couples?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Kodaikanal's pleasant climate, scenic viewpoints, peaceful lake, and romantic landscapes make it one of South India's most popular honeymoon destinations.

faq.question: What is the ideal season for this trip?
faq.answer: The itinerary can be enjoyed throughout the year, with October to June offering the most comfortable weather for sightseeing.

title: Coimbatore & Ooty Delight
shortDescription: Experience the perfect blend of spirituality, nature, and colonial charm as you explore Coimbatore and the breathtaking Nilgiri Hills of Ooty.
highlights: Visit the iconic Adiyogi Shiva Statue
Enjoy boating at Ooty Lake
Explore Doddabetta Peak & Tea Factory
Witness the beauty of Botanical & Rose Gardens
overview: Discover two of Tamil Nadu's most loved destinations on this refreshing three-day getaway. Begin your journey in Coimbatore with visits to its famous spiritual landmarks before heading into the misty Nilgiri Hills. Explore Ooty's lush botanical gardens, panoramic viewpoints, serene lakes, tea plantations, and vibrant local markets. This itinerary perfectly balances sightseeing, relaxation, and scenic beauty, making it ideal for families, honeymooners, and weekend travellers.
pickupLocation: Coimbatore International Airport / Coimbatore Junction Railway Station
accommodation: 2 Nights stay in a premium 3-Star or 4-Star hotel in Ooty on twin/triple sharing basis.
transportation: Private AC Sedan, SUV or Tempo Traveller for all transfers and sightseeing.
weather: Coimbatore remains warm (22°C–34°C), while Ooty enjoys cool weather (10°C–22°C) throughout the year.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Coimbatore & Journey to Ooty
itinerary.morning: Arrive at Coimbatore Airport or Railway Station and meet your tour representative. Visit the magnificent 112-ft Adiyogi Shiva Statue at the Isha Yoga Center and, if time permits, seek blessings at Marudhamalai Murugan Temple.
itinerary.afternoon: Drive through scenic forest roads and tea plantations towards Ooty. Enjoy beautiful viewpoints along the Nilgiri Ghat roads before checking into your hotel.
itinerary.evening: Spend your evening boating at Ooty Lake or exploring Charing Cross Market, famous for homemade chocolates, Nilgiri tea, spices, and handicrafts.

itinerary.title: Explore the Queen of Hill Stations
itinerary.morning: After breakfast, visit Doddabetta Peak for panoramic views of the Nilgiri Hills. Continue to the Tea Factory & Museum to experience tea processing and enjoy fresh tea tasting.
itinerary.afternoon: Explore the Government Botanical Garden, Government Rose Garden, Wax World Museum, and Thread Garden. Later visit the scenic Pine Forest and Shooting Point for photography.
itinerary.evening: Relax at your hotel or explore Ooty's lively cafés before enjoying dinner.

itinerary.title: Pykara Excursion & Departure
